mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is held constant for two consecutive months above 5.0%, market expectations for future rate cuts decline, lowering real discount rates and lifting equity present-value valuations, which drives a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: FOMC holds or cuts rates after a restrictive period
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day moving average of prior non-tightening periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, prompting risk-on sentiment and a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >10% month-over-month AND UNRATE falls by >0.2 percentage points in the same month
regime_hint: Labor market strengthening with low unemployment
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns under this trigger are not statistically outperforming the 60-day mean of the past 24 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly acceleration in consumer demand proxies (HOUST) above the 12-month moving average, while industrial production remains flat, predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates sustained economic momentum.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly growth > 2% AND INDPRO month-over-month change ≈ 0%
regime_hint: Accelerating consumer demand with stable supply
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns under this trigger are negative in >70% of similar events (rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive month of industrial production falling below its 52-week low (INDPRO) while consumer demand (HOUST) remains above trend suggests structural supply-side weakness, which typically precedes a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 52-week low for two consecutive months AND HOUST > 12-month moving average
regime_hint: Persistent industrial production weakness amid resilient demand
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns under this trigger are not statistically lower than the 20-day mean of prior supply shocks (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the annual inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% for three consecutive months, markets anticipate tighter policy, causing a sharp decline in equity valuations and a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns under this trigger are not meaningfully lower than the 60-day mean of prior high-inflation episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden, unanticipated rise in job openings (PAYEMS) without a corresponding increase in job growth (PAYEMS) suggests labor market imbalances and a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as risk aversion increases.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >15% month-over-month AND prior month's change < 0%
regime_hint: Surge in job openings without job growth
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns under this trigger are not statistically lower than the 20-day mean of prior imbalanced labor markets (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for two consecutive months, while real GDP growth (not available in proxy list) is inferred to be stable, creates a risk-off environment that predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns under this trigger are not persistently negative across 10 such events (rolling mean).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of falling retail sales proxies (not available in this catalog) are not directly observable, but a simultaneous rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and a decline in consumer confidence proxies (not available) would imply supply-chain easing. Since only INDPRO is available, this sketch instead uses a proxy: when INDPRO falls by >10% in two consecutive months, markets anticipate softening demand and a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days is less likely.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >10% month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns under this trigger are not statistically lower than the 20-day mean of prior INDPRO contractions (t-test p > 0.05).
